components.name: CtaSection
components.doc: A call to action in three shapes: a centered closing section, a split layout beside a setup card that completes itself in view, and a compact banner that closes its gap when dismissed.

components.name: CtaSectionBlock
components.doc: Preview: all three shapes. Buttons confirm in place; nothing is sent.

members.name: variant
members.doc: `centered` is a closing section, `split` sits beside a product visual, `banner` is one dismissible line.

members.name: secondaryAction
members.doc: Not shown in the banner variant. Pass null to hide it.

members.name: note
members.doc: Small print under the actions in the centered variant, such as "No credit card required".

members.name: faces
members.doc: Faces beside the note in the centered variant. Pass an empty array to hide them.

members.name: points
members.doc: Short benefit lines in the split variant.

members.name: visual
members.doc: Replaces the split variant's setup card.

members.name: onDismiss
members.doc: Banner only: shows a dismiss button and calls this after it closes.

members.name: confirmedLabel
members.doc: With no href or onClick, the button confirms in place with this label, which suits previews.
